tooltips.ownBrandSection: The brand you own and sell directly. AI answers will mention this name (e.g. Roborock, Stanley).
tooltips.shadowBrandSection: When you sell through resellers or retail platforms, the brand name your product actually appears under (e.g. Amazon, Rough Country). AI answers cite these channel brands instead of your company name.
tooltips.shadowChannelProducts: Products sold on this channel — including the channel's own brand-line products and products the channel resells from other suppliers. Tracking these shows which products AI recommends alongside yours on this channel.
tooltips.peerIsAlsoShadow: This brand is both a sales channel and a direct competitor. Its products as a peer are managed on the corresponding card under "Brands".
tooltips.productSubRole: If you know this product's attribution on this channel, you can refine it; if unsure, keep the default "Not distinguished".
tooltips.trackedUrlInput: Exact URL matches this single detail page; path prefix matches any URL starting with the path (e.g. /product/ht-70911 matches all color/variant pages of this product).
tooltips.aiSuggestionsBanner: Our AI offline-scans AI search engine answers and surfaces these brand / product / URL candidates that may not be configured yet. Review and adopt or ignore.
tooltips.suggestionsPanelHeader: Configuration candidates discovered by AI from recent AI search engine answers and your website content. Once adopted, they are included in the next analysis.
tooltips.autoDiscoveryButton: Crawl this URL and let AI extract product / brand candidates. Results take effect only after your confirmation.
tooltips.productName: The specific product or SKU name you want AI to mention and track. Full names give the most accurate attribution; variants are maintained separately.
tooltips.matchVariants: Other spellings of the same product that may appear in AI answers (e.g. model abbreviations, removed spaces, added hyphens). Variants must be at least 3 characters and are case-insensitive.
tooltips.advancedOptions: Optional: in channel-sales scenarios, further specify whether this product is the channel's own brand line or resold from another peer. Leave empty if unsure.
tooltips.ownerPeer: If this product is resold by a channel from a specific peer, you can bind it to the corresponding peer; the Action Agent will attribute channel reports accordingly.
tooltips.trackedUrlsSection: Detail pages for this product on your website or on channel platforms. When AI cites these URLs, the system attributes the citation to this product.
tooltips.urlScope: Exact URL matches only the given URL; path prefix matches any URL starting with the path (e.g. different color variants of the same SKU).
tooltips.salesChannels: Select which channels sell this own-product. Selected channel brands are included in the co-occurrence and multi-channel comparisons on the "Channel Analysis" page.
tooltips.topicsSection: A topic is a semantic label (e.g. "robot vacuum") you want AI search engines to recognize — not a specific SKU. Each topic can hold multiple own-products.
tooltips.peersSection: A peer is a brand in the same category competing for the same mindshare. Maintaining a full alias list per peer significantly improves recognition in AI answers.
tooltips.peerProductsSection: Representative products / SKUs this peer shows up with in AI answers. Attach them to the corresponding topic so they appear as a separate breakdown in Visibility / Citation dashboards.
tooltips.ownProductsSection: Your own-products or SKUs attached to this topic. Each product maintains match variants and tracked URLs so the system can recognize mentions and citations in AI answers.
